10. **Test barcode scanning** — scan a selection of products to verify inventory lookup and pricing.

11. **Sync product catalog and pricing** — ensure the till has the latest product data from the central system.

12. **Run end-to-end test sale** — complete a full transaction (scan, pay, receipt) to confirm everything works.

13. **Lock down the configuration** — restrict user permissions, set the kiosk mode if applicable, and apply any security policies.

    'Tenant ID' फ़ील्ड में निम्नलिखित मान दर्ज करें:
